content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the documents. I would like to propose a few adjustments to the agreement before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause concerning testing fees, you are required to provide products and production runs without compensation up to a set limit for regulatory testing, and I propose that the Client shall pay the Contractor standard fees for all units and production runs required for regulatory testing and validations. - Regarding the relevant clause concerning payment terms, payment is due within 45 days following the end of each calendar quarter, and I propose that payments due under Section 2.2 shall be payable to the Contractor by the Client on a quarterly basis within 30 days following the end of each calendar quarter. Thank you for considering these updates. Best regards,
